top_categories.workout_context: 155 miles. Your legs will beg to quit after 120. This trains the power output you need from mile 130 onward.
Tor Divide's UK Peak District, British gravel forces constant power changes. Surge over the rough stuff, settle on the smooth, repeat for 155 miles.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Tor Divide's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before May.
Tor Divide's uK Peak District gravel rewards steady threshold power. Surging and recovering costs more watts than just holding.
At Tor Divide, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
155 miles rewards fat oxidation. This volume work shifts your fuel mix so you're still burning fat at hour 5, not bonking at hour 3.
Every hard session works better with a bigger aerobic base. At 155 miles, base fitness is the difference between racing and surviving.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Tor Divide. Train it until it feels boring.
Endurance with intensity spikes baked in. Exactly what 5,000ft of climbing on uK Peak District gravel does to your power file on race day.
5,000ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.
How long can you hold 105% FTP before you blow? At Tor Divide, that number decides whether you bridge or get dropped.
5,000ft of climbing means repeated surges above threshold. VO2max work is how you survive the fifth climb, not just the first.

race_overlay.nutrition: Ultra-distance fueling for 155 miles: 80–100g carbs/hour from mile 1 — don’t wait until you’re hungry. Practice your exact race-day nutrition in every long training ride. Carry backup calories. 155 miles burns 8,000–12,000+ calories — you cannot replace them all, but you must try.
race_overlay.terrain: Mixed terrain at Tor Divide requires surface adaptability. Include weekly rides on uk peak district gravel to build confidence. Expect: uk peak district, british gravel, uk.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Durability, Gravel Specific, and Race Simulation to prepare you for 155 miles of uk peak district gravel in Peak District, UK.
